title: S2 · First Contact
note: 'Three Proto-Claimants on a harbour road, forty people behind a stopped tram, and six machines that were issued two hours ago.' Tense going in, real rain on the harbour road. The fight itself gets its own reserved track (04-masamichi-amano-charge-his-name-is-giant-robo, registered in asset-registry.json against this scene) rather than a shuffle -- the campaign's first Frame-scale fight earns the same treatment Flood Tunnel Clearance got for the first fight of any kind.
